cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's coming for lunch. I taught you to check the little things: does this spoon look clean enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's fine. You were supposed to clean the whole kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remember the brief. Now look at the forks; she notices water spots.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've asked her to bring gloves and help you with the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've finally learned to welcome help. Find a towel for her hands, then. Not the faded one—I taught you better than that.

reason: Make A grade B real cleanup concern as basic memory, then convert each solution into another small hosting correction away from its own duty.
